name: Peganum harmala
summary: Peganum harmala is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

warnings.text: A 19-year-old died of multiple organ failure in January 2023 after taking 24 ephedrine asthma tablets, then drinking a home brew of Syrian rue (harmala) and acacia bark boiled for over an hour and a half. Harmala alkaloids are MAOIs: with ephedrine or any other stimulant they can push blood pressure high enough to cause bleeding in the brain and heart failure. Acacia bark can hold 5-MeO-DMT, which is dangerous with an MAOI, and bark bought online may carry pesticides. Have a sober sitter, and put knives and sharp things away first.

summaryZh: 駱駝蓬（學名：Peganum harmala），又名野芸香，臭古朵。是駱駝蓬屬下的一個有著木本地下莖的多年生草本植物物種。駱駝蓬屬舊屬蒺藜科，今屬白刺科。其種子可入藥，是為駱駝蓬子，有致幻效果，是台灣的相思湯的兩種成份之一。
